top_strength: Lukas kept a genuinely confusing, multi-stop job (Rosedale house to storage, then a second Northwest Austin house back to Rosedale, plus a mid-call handoff to the customer's husband) fully organized, accurately capturing every address, item, and disassembly need without losing the thread.
coaching_note: Build the three trust differentiators — No Worries Damage Coverage, Meet Your Mover, and the On-Time Guarantee — plus the 'no hidden fees' pitch and Save Your Ass prep speech into the pricing conversation; none of these were mentioned once across the 11.8-minute call.
phone_presence_notes: Lukas stayed polite and personable with casual affirmations ('gotcha,' 'sweet,' 'alrighty boss') and handled the customer's rambling, disorganized explanations and a mid-call phone handoff without friction, but never used the customer's name and had a couple of flustered moments ('Why is it not scrolling?'), keeping the rapport transactional rather than warm.
